title: Quixel: "The full Quixel Megascans library is going free. We’ve updated terms for all Quixel assets so you can train AI models on Megascans & Megaplants."
author: Recoil42

comments.author: Equal_Passenger9791
comments.body:
AI ate half of their business model so they picked the good option and made it free.

More to come just like it

replies.author: Recoil42
replies.body:
>AI ate half of their business model

Quixel is owned by Epic, so it's more like a pet project for a much larger corp.
